messages:
nina_cs: Aurum Clinical asked to onboard 'ClaimSieve' v0.9 for intake summarization + structured PHI extraction. They want a short pilot: 10 days, dedicated test cluster, strict PHI controls. Main asks: SSN masking, patient_id preservation, audit logs for every request. Latency SLO requested p50 <250ms, p95 <600ms. Can we scope?
arjun_ml: I can take evaluation lead. Need sample payloads and desired labels. Any regulatory constraints (HIPAA, BAAs)?
nina_cs: Signed BAA in place. Samples uploaded to secure bucket: s3://aurum/claims/for-eval. Labels desired: patient_name, dob, ssn_masked, patient_id, total_billed, diagnosis_codes. They want entity F1 >=97% for critical PHI fields.
olivia_eng: Quick question: will this run in their VPC or our dedicated pool? Also expected concurrent connections?
nina_cs: Prefer dedicated in our cloud with private networking and KMS integration. Expect burst to 30rps, sustained ~8rps.
tara_ops: Ops can allocate a 2xA100 pool for 10 days. Need formal reservation ticket + billing OK. @deploy-bot please open ticket.
deploy-bot: Ticket INF-9102 opened: aurum-claims-pilot (10d, 2xA100). Provisioning after billing approval.
kevin_enable: I'll prepare an onboarding runbook and customer acceptance criteria sheet. Proposed preflight call Thursday 9am PT with Aurum, SRE, ML lead.
arjun_ml: Eval plan: get a labeled 300-doc holdout, run extraction metrics, PHI-leakage probe, and hallucination stress tests. We'll compare quantized 13B vs 70B baseline for quality delta. Also include token-level audit check for any raw SSN emissions.
privacy-bot: Reminder: include automated redaction verification, token overlap check, and simulated prompt-injection tests. Fail if any SSN appears unmasked in outputs.
olivia_eng: For rollout policy, suggest canary traffic and automatic fallback to baseline model on quality regression. Example policy snippet (ops): `route: /claimsieve, variants: [{name:13b-q, pct:10},{name:13b-q-stable, pct:90}], rollback_on: {error_rate:2%, latency_p95_ms:700}`
tara_ops: Cost estimate ~9.5k for 10-day dedicated eval. Billing, please confirm.
nina_cs: I'll push PO today. Marking account health = AT-RISK until pilot completes. If pilot doesn't start within 4 business days escalate to CSM lead.
arjun_ml: After access, initial bench + safety tests within 48h, then a short A/B vs 70B. I'll produce a short report: latency percentiles, entity precision/recall, PHI leakage count, and recommended config (KV cache + batching settings).
kevin_enable: Adding items to preflight checklist: BAA copy, PO, labeled 300-doc subset, KMS contact, VPN or peering info, acceptance criteria doc. I'll DM Aurum the invite.
deploy-bot: INF-9102 updated with cost and wait state.
privacy-bot: Schedule nightly PHI-leak scans during pilot. Send alerts on any leakage.
nina_cs: Thanks team. I'll update the thread with ticket/PO links and schedule the preflight. :thumbsup:
